title: do not record has_slice until the slice file exists, and have promote --force keep an existing Why body

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The implementer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on slicer in ork run ork-20261117-220113-e6de, project ork, item S396:

do not record has_slice until the slice file exists, and have promote --force keep an existing Why body

Evidence: after merging 5f9e52bd, slicer check said S412-S415 were marked as having a slice but no file existed; promote --force created the files with an empty Why, so each Why had to be restored with slicer edit from main commit 1527d8c2
